answer.book: Corpus doctrinae Christianae (Ursinus/Pareus, Ecclesiarum a Papatu Romano reformatarum, Hanover 1634 printing): front matter and dedications, Prolegomena in two parts, the Heidelberg Catechism explained in 129 questions in three parts, then miscellaneous tracts (Aphorisms, Thema saeculare, Athanasian Creed commentary, Hunnius disputation, Arminianism examen) and a subject index.
